question: Which factors (root orientation, passive neck, passive antenna joints a2 / a3 / arista, gravity tilt) account for the change of the live JO drive d from stored state 0 to (Q1) the last pre-tilt state 5005 and (Q2) the 520-2000 ms window mean, in the 36 Step C seed arms?
not_claimed: fly physiology of the antenna or neck stiffness
any change to the encoder or Step C labels
behavioural effect of the operating point

sources.step_c_arms: the 36 seed arms (OFF/G1/FLIP x UP/DOWN x seeds 13-18), local raw .json.gz, each verified against report.json arm_sha256; REPRO_N0_7 not used
sources.model: malecns_backend.embodiment._windows_m7d_corrected_spontaneous_adapter._runtime (the Step B runtime); AntennaFrames.drive unchanged; a separate MjData, mj_forward per evaluation

tick_state_mapping.rule: neural tick k (1-based, time 0.5k ms) encoded d from the qpos of stored state 5k, with the gravity in force at that moment: the rotated vector if 5k >= the arm's tilt_state (5005), else (0, 0, -9810). The recorded gravity of state 5005 itself is (0, 0, -9810) because it is captured before the rotation.
tick_state_mapping.how_fixed: from two discarded plumbing smokes of the unchanged Step C module (60 steps tilt 22; 40 steps tilt 20; scratch output, not evidence): qpos(5k) reproduced recorded d with difference 0 on every tick (5k-1 and 5k+1 did not); gravity switched exactly at 5k >= tilt_state. No evidence arm was inspected for this.

factors.A3: joint_{L,R}Funiculus_yaw, joint_{L,R}Funiculus, joint_{L,R}Funiculus_roll (qpos 79-81, 88-90); the a2-a3 joint
factors.resolution: addresses resolved from exact joint names in the model and asserted equal to the listed qpos addresses; all other qpos (root position, legs) held at the target value (they do not enter d)
factors.side_note: each antenna factor covers both sides; d_L does not depend on right antenna joints and vice versa

attribution.reference: stored state 0 of the same arm: its qpos and gravity (0, 0, -9810)
attribution.method: exact Shapley values over the 6 factors: v(S) = d with factors in S at target and the rest at reference; all 64 subsets evaluated; phi_i = sum over S not containing i of |S|!(5-|S|)!/6! (v(S+i) - v(S))

targets.T_pre: stored state 5005 with its recorded gravity (0, 0, -9810); GRAVITY contributes 0
targets.T_win: stored states 5200, 5250, ..., 20000 (297 states) with their recorded gravity; contributions and total averaged over the states

integrity.J1_inputs: report sha equals the above; all 36 arm files present and their sha256 equal report arm_sha256
integrity.J2_replay: for every neural tick of every arm, d recomputed by the tick_state_mapping equals recorded jo_d on both sides within 1e-9
integrity.J3_reference: d at state 0 with gravity (0, 0, -9810) equals the Step B rest d per side within 1e-4, in every arm
integrity.factor_addresses: joint-name resolution equals the declared qpos addresses (else INCONCLUSIVE_INTEGRITY)

labels.NO_MATERIAL_DRIFT: |median over arms of the total change| < 0.01
labels.DOMINANT_<factor>: otherwise, the factor's median over arms of phi/total >= 0.5 and sign(phi) == sign(total) in >= 90% of the arms of the group; if several factors qualify (possible when other shares are negative), the one with the largest median share

reported_not_labelled: per factor: median and range of phi and of phi/total per group and side
A3 (a2-a3) and A2 joint angles (deg) at state 0, T_pre and window mean
neck joint angles (deg) at state 0, T_pre and window mean
thorax pitch and roll relative to gravity (Step C body_angles) at state 0, T_pre and window mean
tilt contrast decomposition: for each seed and arm type, the Shapley decomposition of d(DOWN state) - d(UP state) with the UP state as reference, averaged over the T_win states
by arm type (OFF, G1, FLIP): Q1 and Q2 factor medians

declared_interpretation.ROOT: offset is a postural state of the assisted-posture context; a later design sets its tilt range around the live operating point; encoder unchanged
declared_interpretation.NECK: offset comes from the uncontrolled passive neck (model limitation; real flies stabilise the head); recorded as a confound for JO steps; any fix needs its own design
declared_interpretation.A2_A3_ARISTA: offset is passive sag of antenna joints with uncalibrated FlyGym default stiffness; the a2-a3 joint is the JO site, so a follow-up compares the a3-orientation encoder with an a2-a3 joint reading, stating no stiffness is calibrated
declared_interpretation.GRAVITY_in_Q2: expected to be large in Q2 (it is the tilt); reported, and the posture share beside it is the quantity of interest
declared_interpretation.MIXED: reported as is; any follow-up must handle all factors
declared_interpretation.all: no encoder, threshold or Step C label change

interpretation_limits: Geometric attribution of a recorded state; no causal neural claim.
Shapley attribution of a nonlinear function depends on the declared reference (state 0 of each arm).
One context (assisted posture, Step C arms).
Joint stiffnesses are FlyGym defaults; nothing is calibrated.
No motor coordinate status change (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
single_run: Analysis run once after protocol, code and tests are committed and pushed; evaluated once.
